I have had this small plot of fruit trees since my mother was alive, and it is only 0.11 hectares. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer from the cooperative because one bag is too big and too costly for such a small piece, and I need my cash for the other plots. I will spread cow dung around the trees like I do every year, and I will weed it myself with my daughters when the rains come. I do not use spray chemicals or hire workers because I have no money for that.
